'''Type 50 Yinglung Hands PPE''' is a {{gear|5|Gloves}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Hongshan Swordmancers and assembled by the AIC. This equipment can improve the wearer's combat capabilities.|A civilian version of Yinglung Special Task Force equipment. The lack of a crucial power component actually improved its compatibility with general users. 
"Thus he wondered: if he were the one who had to face that Nefarith amidst the massive tidal wave of Blight, would he have the courage to pick up a weapon?"}}
